verdict.rationale: Fern docs live in a source repository, and Fern Agent and its automations open pull requests for proposed changes, so a Git-based PR review flow is implied before publishing. Comments, approvals and merging appear to come from the Git host rather than Fern, and the docs mention preview options but don't tie them to review. Missing for 10: first-party review comments and approval workflow, documented merge-to-publish gating, a review flow for Fern Editor (non-Git) changes, and independent corroboration.
